_comment: model_version: the hub metadata model_version for this model; calibration: spread multipliers around the median for horizons 0-3, per target; refit: retrain on all windows after early stopping; ed_model: "obshyb" submits the ED target from the DMAPRIME-ObsHYB networks (the Flu MetroCast model) instead of this model, except where they have no forecast; "hyb" or absent: this model
